content.text: The shared cursor already stores both timestamp and ID, but the resume predicate compares only the timestamp. When a page ends inside a timestamp batch, every remaining row at that timestamp gets excluded. I’m fixing the shared predicate to resume by the same timestamp-plus-ID order used in each query; tenant scoping remains part of each repository’s filters.
